svg.aria-label: The FBPINN idea on a 1D domain. The x axis is split into overlapping subdomains, each with its own small tanh network (2 by 16 in 2023, 1 by 16 later) that sees its input mapped to [-1, 1]. Smooth windows over each subdomain sum to 1, each net output is multiplied by its window and the pieces are summed into one solution curve, and the hard boundary constraint is applied last. The windows blend neighbours, so there are no interface loss terms.
